result.title: Agentic On-Policy Distillation Implicitly Reshapes LLMs' ReAct Patterns
result.summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers specialized capabilities to language-model agents, but its cross-domain effects on interaction remain unclear. We investigate how OPD reshapes ReAct interaction patterns across mathematics, ALFWorld, and $τ^2$-bench, focusing on reasoning, actions, and observation acquisition. General-reasoning supervision reduces mathematical tool attempts from 70.4% to 14.4% while increasing accuracy from 16.7% to 38.0%; code-interpreter supervision improves household actions and retail queries. In contrast, ALFWorld supervision reduces $τ^2$-bench accuracy from 41.5% to 6.6%, accompanied by frequent tool calls that violate user-information dependencies. To address negative transfer using only source-domain training trajectories, we explore selective OPD guided by teacher preference changes before and after domain-specific RL. Retaining the top 95% of positions raises $τ^2$ accuracy from 11.5% to 29.9% with a source-learning trade-off.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 on-policy distillation 如何改变 LLM agent 在数学、ALFWorld 与 τ²-bench 上的 ReAct 交互模式（推理、动作与观察获取），并提出依据教师偏好变化筛选位置的 selective OPD 以缓解跨域负迁移。
AI.relevance_reason: 其按教师偏好变化选择蒸馏位置、缓解跨域负迁移的做法，可能为 LVR 的轨迹训练与监督分配提供可核查线索；但研究对象是纯文本 agent，与视觉状态无直接联系。
